title: Bond notification afb.notification.bond.v1
description: AFB-side MQTT notification payload published to <topic_base>/system/<user_id> about an event of a bond the user holds in a portfolio: an offer, a maturity, an amortization, an issuer call, or a price/volume anomaly signal. Consumed by the AFB informer daemon (Telegram/email) exactly like alarm/deal/link/system/expiration notifications — informer never reads AFB settings, the recipient and channels come only from `user`. Event notices are sent at most once per (user, bond, `kind`, `stage`, event date) and not at all when the user's `bonds.notice_days` is 0; anomaly notices are not sent when `bonds.notify_anomaly` is false. NOT an AsyncAPI wire message — never crosses the AFB<->BF channel, not signed. `timestamp` is added by MQTTPublisher at publish time.

notification_id.description: Stable id for informer-side deduplication, built from user + secid + kind + stage + event date (signal date for an anomaly).

kind.description: `offer` — buyback offer (with the application window); `maturity` — redemption; `amortization` — partial repayment of the face value; `call` — issuer's call option; `anomaly` — price/volume anomaly signal.

stage.description: `warn` — `notice_days` threshold reached; `window_open` — the offer application window has opened; `window_last_day` — the last day of the offer window; `d0` — the event day; `signal` — an anomaly (only with kind `anomaly`, and only it).

shortname.description: Short display name of the bond.

event_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: date of the event (absent for an anomaly).

window_start.description: Start of the offer application window (offer only).

window_end.description: End of the offer application window (offer only).

days_left.description: Calendar days from the notice date to `event_date` (0 on the event day).

amount.description: Amount of the event for the held quantity.

currency.description: Currency of the bond face value.

portfolios.description: The user's portfolios that hold the bond.

rules.description: Codes of the triggered anomaly rules (anomaly only).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 publish time; added by MQTTPublisher, not by the notification builder.
